query: SELECT COALESCE(f.observed_hash, f.hash) AS digest, count(DISTINCT f.product_id)::bigint AS held FROM product_file f JOIN product p ON p.org_id = f.org_id AND p.id = f.product_id WHERE f.org_id = $1 AND f.role = 'payload' AND f.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(f.observed_hash, f.hash) = ANY($2) GROUP BY 1
